summary: OpenAI previewed "Ultrafast" mode, a new API service tier running GPT-5.6 Sol up to 14x faster using Cerebras hardware, delivering up to 750 output tokens per second.

mechanisms.reason: The new fast inference tier is explicitly powered by Cerebras silicon rather than merchant GPU hardware, indicating a shift toward alternative accelerator providers.
mechanisms.quote: Powered by Cerebras, it delivers up to 750 output tokens per second.

mechanisms.reason: A dramatically faster inference tier could enable higher-throughput or more latency-sensitive use cases, increasing aggregate token volume.
